result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B fixes the problems that would show up in real use: it removes the gradient, drop shadow and hairline outline, thickens the route line, makes the summit hold visible, and enlarges and darkens the tagline, giving a reason for each change while keeping the concept. A only tidies the code. It keeps the shadow and gradient, and it calls the Papyrus dependency a problem but leaves it as is. Neither answer swaps out Papyrus or shows a true one-color or small-size version, but B's flat shape and thicker strokes get much closer and it offers those variants. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A removes the gradient, drop shadow and hairline outline, which are the real problems, and explains each change. It also fixes the invisible summit hold. B mostly keeps those problems and only makes code-level tweaks. Neither one replaces Papyrus, though A says outright that it is the weakest part of the logo. Only A deals with single-color and small-size use, and even then it mostly offers to do that work next rather than showing it.
